name: D. Mark Anderson
occupation: Uinta County commissioner and board chairman (re-elected November 2026)
prior_offices: Uinta County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; listed as chairman on the official elected officials list)
background: David Mark Anderson, also listed as D. Mark Anderson and Mark Anderson, is chairman of the Uinta County Board of Commissioners and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official elected officials list names Mark Anderson as chairman, with a term expiring in 2027. He won the November 2022 general election.
